title: Imtihon strategiyasi: vaqt va stress
goal_uz: Dars oxirida IELTS va C1 Advanced bo‘limlari uchun daqiqalarigacha aniq vaqt rejasini tuzasiz, stressni nafas va vaqt yutadigan iboralar bilan boshqarasiz, savollarni ball bo‘yicha tartiblaysiz va javoblarni so‘z cheklovi, ko‘plik va shaxsiy xatolar bo‘yicha maqsadli tekshirasiz.

scenes.title: Imtihon strategiyasi
board: Exam strategy: time and stress
(Imtihon strategiyasi: vaqt va stress)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda C1 darajasida ham qolib ketadigan xatolarni ko‘rdik va to‘rt bosqichli tekshirish ro‘yxatini tuzdik. Bugun til emas, imtihonning o‘zi haqida gaplashamiz: vaqtni qanday taqsimlash, stressni qanday boshqarish, qaysi savolga birinchi kirishish va javoblarni qanday tekshirish. Bir xil darajadagi ikki kishi turli ball olishi mumkin, chunki ball imtihon sharoitida o‘zingizni qanday tutishingizga ham bog‘liq. Dars oxirida o‘zingizning shaxsiy imtihon rejangizni tuza olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we tackled persistent errors. Today we focus on the exam itself: managing time, handling stress, prioritising questions and checking your answers.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar qaysar xatolar bilan ishladik. Bugun imtihonning o‘ziga e’tibor qaratamiz: vaqtni boshqarish, stress bilan kurashish, savollarni tartiblash va javoblarni tekshirish.

scenes.title: Imtihon tuzilishi
board: IELTS: Listening ~30 · Reading 60 · Writing 60 · Speaking 11–14 min
C1 Advanced: Reading & Use of English 90 · Writing 90
Listening ~40 · Speaking ~15 min
scenes.say_native: Avval imtihon tuzilishini aniq bilish kerak. IELTS da tinglash taxminan o‘ttiz daqiqa, o‘qish oltmish daqiqa, yozish oltmish daqiqa, gapirish o‘n bir dan o‘n to‘rt daqiqagacha. Cambridge C1 Advanced da o‘qish va Use of English to‘qson daqiqa, yozish ham to‘qson daqiqa, tinglash qirq daqiqaga yaqin, gapirish o‘n besh daqiqa atrofida. Rejani har doim aniq raqamlar asosida tuzasiz.
scenes.say: IELTS Reading and Writing: sixty minutes each. C1 Advanced Reading and Use of English, and Writing: ninety minutes each.
scenes.say_uz: IELTS o‘qish va yozish: oltmish daqiqadan. C1 Advanced o‘qish va Use of English hamda yozish: to‘qson daqiqadan.

scenes.title: Birinchi nuqta: har bir ball uchun vaqt
board: Time ÷ marks = minutes per mark
IELTS Reading: 60 min ÷ 40 = 1.5 min per question
Stuck for 3+ minutes? Move on.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: har bir bo‘lim uchun vaqt rejasi. Oddiy hisobdan boshlaymiz: vaqtni ballar soniga bo‘lasiz. IELTS o‘qishda oltmish daqiqa va qirqta savol, demak bitta savolga o‘rtacha bir yarim daqiqa. Agar bitta savolga uch daqiqadan ko‘p ketayotgan bo‘lsa, bu boshqa ikki savolning vaqtini yeyapti degani. Shuning uchun belgilab qo‘yib, keyingisiga o‘tasiz.
scenes.say: Sixty minutes for forty questions: about a minute and a half each. Three minutes on one question steals time from two others.
scenes.say_uz: Qirqta savolga oltmish daqiqa: har biriga bir yarim daqiqa. Bitta savolga uch daqiqa ikki savolning vaqtini o‘g‘irlaydi.

scenes.title: O‘qish bo‘limi rejasi
board: No extra transfer time in Reading!
scenes.say_native: IELTS o‘qishda uchta matn bor va ular odatda tobora qiyinlashadi. Shuning uchun vaqtni teng emas, taxminan o‘n yetti, yigirma va yigirma uch daqiqa qilib bo‘lish mantiqli. Muhim eslatma: qog‘ozda topshiriladigan o‘qishda javoblarni varaqaga ko‘chirish uchun alohida vaqt berilmaydi. Javoblarni darhol varaqaga yozing yoki har bir matn oxirida ko‘chiring.
scenes.say: Give the passages roughly seventeen, twenty and twenty-three minutes. There's no extra time to transfer answers.
scenes.say_uz: Matnlarga taxminan o‘n yetti, yigirma va yigirma uch daqiqa ajrating. Javoblarni ko‘chirishga qo‘shimcha vaqt yo‘q.

scenes.title: Yozish bo‘limi rejasi
board: Task 1: 20 min → plan 3 · write 14 · check 3
Task 2: 40 min → plan 5 · write 30 · check 5
Task 2 carries twice the weight of Task 1
scenes.say_native: IELTS yozishda ikki topshiriq bor. Birinchisiga yigirma daqiqa, ikkinchisiga qirq daqiqa tavsiya etiladi, chunki ikkinchi topshiriq ballga ikki baravar ko‘p ta’sir qiladi. Har bir topshiriq ichida ham reja bor: rejalashtirish, yozish va tekshirish. Ko‘pchilik rejalashtirishni vaqt yo‘qotish deb o‘ylaydi, aslida besh daqiqalik reja yozish jarayonini tezlashtiradi.
scenes.say: Twenty minutes for Task 1, forty for Task 2, which carries twice the weight. Plan, write, then check.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi topshiriqqa yigirma, ikki baravar og‘irroq ikkinchisiga qirq daqiqa. Rejalashtiring, yozing, keyin tekshiring.

scenes.title: Tinglash bo‘limida vaqt
board: Use pauses to read ahead
Missed one? Let it go, follow the next
Paper-based IELTS: 10 min to transfer · computer: 2 min to check
scenes.say_native: Tinglashda vaqtni siz emas, audio boshqaradi. Shuning uchun asosiy qoida: har bir pauzadan keyingi savollarni oldindan o‘qish uchun foydalaning. Bitta javobni o‘tkazib yuborsangiz, unga yopishib qolmang, keyingi savolga o‘ting, aks holda ikki-uchtasini yo‘qotasiz. Qog‘ozdagi IELTS da oxirida javoblarni ko‘chirish uchun o‘n daqiqa, kompyuterda esa tekshirish uchun ikki daqiqa beriladi.
scenes.say: Use every pause to read ahead. If you miss an answer, let it go and follow the next one.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir pauzada oldinga o‘qing. Javobni o‘tkazib yuborsangiz, qo‘yib yuboring va keyingisini kuzating.

scenes.title: Nazorat nuqtalari
board: Write checkpoint times on the question paper
e.g. 10:17 → Passage 2 · 10:37 → Passage 3
Check the clock only at checkpoints
scenes.say_native: Rejani boshda yozib qo‘ying. Imtihon boshlanishi bilan savol varaqasining burchagiga nazorat nuqtalarini yozing: masalan, o‘qish soat o‘nda boshlansa, o‘n-u o‘n yettida ikkinchi matn, o‘n-u o‘ttiz yettida uchinchi matn. Soatga har daqiqada qaramang, faqat nazorat nuqtalarida qarang. Imtihon qoidalarini oldindan bilib oling: ko‘pincha xonadagi soatga tayanasiz.
scenes.say: Write your checkpoint times on the question paper, and look at the clock only at those points.
scenes.say_uz: Nazorat vaqtlarini savol varaqasiga yozing va soatga faqat shu nuqtalarda qarang.

scenes.title: Vaqt bilan bog‘liq xatolar
board: ✗ 10 minutes on one difficult question
✗ 35 minutes on Writing Task 1
✗ No time left to transfer Reading answers
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik vaqt xatosi. Birinchisi, bitta qiyin savolga o‘n daqiqa sarflash: bu bitta ball, qolgan ballar esa kutib turibdi. Ikkinchisi, yozishning birinchi topshirig‘iga o‘ttiz besh daqiqa ketkazish va og‘irroq ikkinchi topshiriqqa shoshilish. Uchinchisi, o‘qishda javoblarni varaqaga ko‘chirishga vaqt qoldirmaslik. Bu uchala xato ham reja bo‘lmaganidan kelib chiqadi.
scenes.say: Don't spend ten minutes on one question worth one mark. Don't let Task 1 swallow thirty-five minutes. And never leave your Reading answers on the question paper.
scenes.say_uz: Bir ballik savolga o‘n daqiqa sarflamang. Birinchi topshiriq o‘ttiz besh daqiqani yutib yubormasin. O‘qish javoblarini hech qachon savol varaqasida qoldirmang.

scenes.title: Rejani hisoblang
board: 1) Writing starts at 11:00. When should you start Task 2?
2) Reading starts at 9:30. When do you move to Passage 3?
3) Task 2: 40 min. How long for planning?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta savolga hisoblab javob bering. Birinchi: yozish soat o‘n birda boshlandi, ikkinchi topshiriqqa qachon o‘tasiz? Ikkinchi: o‘qish to‘qqiz-u o‘ttizda boshlandi, uchinchi matnga qachon o‘tasiz? Uchinchi: ikkinchi topshiriqning qirq daqiqasidan rejalashtirishga qancha ajratasiz? Javobni inglizcha ayting.
scenes.say: One. Writing starts at eleven. When should you start Task 2? Two. Reading starts at half past nine. When do you move to Passage 3? Three. How long should you plan Task 2?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Yozish o‘n birda boshlanadi. Ikkinchi topshiriqni qachon boshlaysiz? Ikki. O‘qish to‘qqiz-u o‘ttizda boshlanadi. Uchinchi matnga qachon o‘tasiz? Uch. Ikkinchi topshiriqni qancha rejalashtirasiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) About 5 minutes
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: o‘n bir-u yigirmada, chunki birinchi topshiriqqa yigirma daqiqa. Ikkinchi: o‘n-u yetti daqiqada, chunki o‘n yetti va yigirma daqiqa, jami o‘ttiz yetti daqiqa o‘tadi. Uchinchi: taxminan besh daqiqa. Bu raqamlar qat’iy qonun emas, mashq paytida o‘zingizga mos variantni topasiz. Muhimi, imtihonga tayyor reja bilan kiring.
scenes.say: Start Task 2 at twenty past eleven. Move to Passage 3 at seven minutes past ten. And spend about five minutes planning Task 2.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi topshiriqni o‘n bir-u yigirmada boshlang. Uchinchi matnga o‘n-u yetti daqiqada o‘ting. Ikkinchi topshiriqni rejalashtirishga taxminan besh daqiqa sarflang.

scenes.title: Tinglash: mock imtihondan keyin
board: Malika: I didn't even finish Passage 3.
Ben: How long did you spend on the headings?
Ben: Next time, flag it and move on.
scenes.say_native: Endi dialogni tinglang. Malika va Ben sinov o‘qish imtihonidan chiqishdi. Malika uchinchi matnni tugata olmadi. Uning vaqti qayerda ketganiga va Ben qanday maslahat berganiga e’tibor bering. Keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz. Ayniqsa, raqamlarga quloq soling.
scenes.say: Malika: I didn't even finish Passage 3. Ben: What happened? Malika: The headings in Passage 2. I spent ages on one paragraph. Ben: How long? Malika: Maybe twelve minutes. Ben: That's the problem. Next time, flag it and move on, and come back if there's time. Malika: And I copied my answers at the very end, in a panic. Ben: Transfer them after each passage. It takes a minute.
scenes.say_uz: Malika: Uchinchi matnni tugata olmadim ham. Ben: Nima bo‘ldi? Malika: Ikkinchi matndagi sarlavhalar. Bitta xatboshiga juda ko‘p vaqt ketdi. Ben: Qancha? Malika: O‘n ikki daqiqacha. Ben: Muammo shu. Keyingi safar belgilab qo‘yib, o‘tib keting, vaqt bo‘lsa qaytasiz. Malika: Javoblarni ham eng oxirida, vahima ichida ko‘chirdim. Ben: Har bir matndan keyin ko‘chiring. Bir daqiqa oladi.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) Where did Malika lose time?
2) What is Ben's first piece of advice?
3) When should she transfer her answers?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: Malika vaqtni qayerda yo‘qotdi va qancha? Ikkinchi: Benning birinchi maslahati nima? Uchinchi: javoblarni varaqaga qachon ko‘chirish kerak? Javoblaringizni inglizcha to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni yana bir marta eshiting.
scenes.say: Question one. Where did Malika lose time? Question two. What is Ben's first piece of advice? Question three. When should she transfer her answers?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi savol. Malika vaqtni qayerda yo‘qotdi? Ikkinchi savol. Benning birinchi maslahati nima? Uchinchi savol. U javoblarni qachon ko‘chirishi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) On one heading question in Passage 2 (~12 min)
2) Flag it, move on, come back later
3) After each passage
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ikkinchi matndagi sarlavha topshirig‘ida, bitta xatboshiga taxminan o‘n ikki daqiqa ketgan. Ikkinchi: flag it and move on, ya’ni belgilab qo‘yib o‘tib ketish va vaqt qolsa qaytish. Uchinchi: har bir matndan keyin. E’tibor bering, spent ages iborasi juda ko‘p vaqt sarflamoq degani, bu og‘zaki nutqda keng tarqalgan.
scenes.say: She lost about twelve minutes on one heading in Passage 2. Ben tells her to flag it and move on. She should transfer her answers after each passage.
scenes.say_uz: U ikkinchi matndagi bitta sarlavhaga taxminan o‘n ikki daqiqa yo‘qotdi. Ben unga belgilab, o‘tib ketishni maslahat beradi. U javoblarni har bir matndan keyin ko‘chirishi kerak.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi nuqta: stress nima qiladi?
board: Some stress = focus
Too much stress = blank mind, rushed reading
Goal: control, not zero stress
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: stressni boshqarish. Biroz hayajon foydali: diqqatni jamlaydi, sizni hushyor qiladi. Lekin stress haddan oshsa, xayol bo‘shab qoladi, savolni shoshib o‘qiysiz va oddiy narsalarni ham o‘tkazib yuborasiz. Maqsad stressni butunlay yo‘q qilish emas, uni nazorat qilish. Buning uchun oddiy, lekin mashq qilingan usullar kerak.
scenes.say: A little stress sharpens your focus. Too much, and your mind goes blank or you start reading too fast. The goal isn't zero stress; it's stress under control.
scenes.say_uz: Ozgina stress diqqatni o‘tkirlashtiradi. Haddan oshsa, xayol bo‘shab qoladi yoki juda tez o‘qiy boshlaysiz. Maqsad stresssizlik emas, nazoratdagi stress.

scenes.title: Nafas bilan boshqarish
board: Breathe in: 4 counts
Breathe out: 6 counts
Repeat 3–4 times before each section
scenes.say_native: Eng tez ishlaydigan usul nafas. Burun orqali to‘rtgacha sanab nafas oling, keyin oltigacha sanab sekin chiqaring. Nafas chiqarish olishdan uzunroq bo‘lishi muhim, bu tanani tinchlantiradi. Har bir bo‘lim oldidan uch-to‘rt marta takrorlang. Bu usulni imtihon kuni birinchi marta sinamang, uni oldindan, uyda mashq paytida odat qiling.
scenes.say: Breathe in for four, out for six. Do it three or four times before each section.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtgacha nafas oling, oltigacha chiqaring. Har bir bo‘lim oldidan uch-to‘rt marta qiling.

scenes.title: O‘zingizga nima deysiz?
board: ✗ I'm going to fail.
✓ I've prepared for this. One question at a time.
Nervous ≈ excited: the body feels the same
scenes.say_native: Ichki ovozingiz ham muhim. I am going to fail degan fikr stressni kuchaytiradi. Uning o‘rniga aniq va real gaplarni ayting: men tayyorlandim, bitta-bitta savol bilan ishlayman. Hayajon va qo‘rquvni tana deyarli bir xil his qiladi: yurak tez uradi, kaftlar terlaydi. Shuning uchun bu holatni men tayyorman, organizmim ishga tushdi deb talqin qilish mumkin.
scenes.say: Swap I'm going to fail for: I've prepared for this. One question at a time.
scenes.say_uz: I am going to fail o‘rniga: men bunga tayyorlandim, bitta-bitta savol.

scenes.title: Imtihondan oldingi tartib
board: Practise under real timing (mock exams)
Sleep well; no cramming the night before
Arrive early; know the rules and the room
scenes.say_native: Stressning katta qismi noma’lumlikdan keladi. Shuning uchun tayyorgarlik paytida haqiqiy vaqt bilan sinov imtihonlarini ishlang, shunda imtihon tanish bo‘lib qoladi. Oxirgi kechada yangi narsa yodlamang, yaxshi uxlang. Imtihon joyiga erta boring, qoidalar va hujjatlarni oldindan tekshiring. Kutilmagan narsa qancha kam bo‘lsa, xotirjamlik shuncha ko‘p bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Do full mocks under real timing. Sleep instead of cramming. Arrive early.
scenes.say_uz: Haqiqiy vaqt bilan to‘liq sinovlar ishlang. Yodlash o‘rniga uxlang. Erta boring.

scenes.title: Gapirishda vaqt yutish
board: That's an interesting question. Let me think…
I've never really thought about that, but…
What I mean is…

examples.t: That's an interesting question. Let me think for a moment.
examples.uz: Qiziq savol. Bir oz o‘ylab olay.

examples.t: I've never really thought about that, but I suppose…
examples.uz: Bu haqda hech o‘ylab ko‘rmaganman, lekin menimcha…

scenes.say_native: Gapirish bo‘limida stressning eng katta belgisi jimlik. Savolni eshitib, xayolingiz bo‘shab qolsa, jim turmang, vaqt yutadigan ibora ishlating. That’s an interesting question, let me think. I’ve never really thought about that, but. Bu iboralar sizga ikki-uch soniya beradi va imtihon oluvchiga ravon gapirayotganingizni ko‘rsatadi. Faqat har bir javobni shu bilan boshlamang.
scenes.say: That's an interesting question. Let me think for a moment. I've never really thought about that, but I suppose it depends.
scenes.say_uz: Qiziq savol. Bir oz o‘ylab olay. Bu haqda hech o‘ylab ko‘rmaganman, lekin menimcha bu bog‘liq.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: bog‘lash va kuchsiz shakllar
board: That's‿an‿interesting question → /ðæts ən/
Let me /ˈlemi/ think
I've never‿really thought‿about‿it
scenes.say_native: Bu iboralar tabiiy eshitilishi uchun ularni bog‘lab ayting. That’s an interesting da an kuchsiz shaklda, schwa bilan aytiladi va oldingi so‘zga qo‘shilib ketadi: thatsan. Let me ko‘pincha lemi kabi eshitiladi. Thought about it da t va a qo‘shiladi. Agar har bir so‘zni alohida, kuchli aytsangiz, ibora yodlangan bo‘lib eshitiladi va maqsadga yetmaydi.
scenes.say: That's an interesting question. Let me think. I've never really thought about it. Link the words together, and keep the small words weak.
scenes.say_uz: Qiziq savol. O‘ylab olay. Bu haqda hech o‘ylamaganman. So‘zlarni bog‘lang, kichik so‘zlarni kuchsiz ayting.

scenes.title: Ovoz chiqarib takrorlang
board: That's an interesting question. Let me think.
I've never really thought about that, but…
Let me put it another way.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Har bir iborani bog‘lab, ravon ayting. An va about dagi birinchi tovush kuchsiz bo‘lsin. Ohangni pasaytirib tugating, shunda ishonchli eshitiladi. Har birini ikki marta ayting, ikkinchisida o‘zingizni haqiqiy imtihonda deb tasavvur qiling.
scenes.say: That's an interesting question. Let me think. I've never really thought about that, but. Let me put it another way.
scenes.say_uz: Qiziq savol. O‘ylab olay. Bu haqda hech o‘ylab ko‘rmaganman, lekin. Boshqacha aytib beray.

scenes.title: Tekshiramiz
board: /ðæts ən ˈɪntrəstɪŋ/
/ˈlemi ˈθɪŋk/
/aɪv ˈnevə ˈrɪəli ˈθɔːt əˈbaʊt ðæt/
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Interesting so‘zida odatda uch bo‘g‘in eshitiladi: IN-tres-ting, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Thought so‘zida th tishlar orasidan chiqadi, uzun o tovushi bilan. Never va really dagi r Britaniya talaffuzida oxirida aytilmaydi. Agar iboralaringiz shoshilib emas, bir tekis va ravon chiqqan bo‘lsa, maqsadga yetdingiz.
scenes.say: Interesting: three syllables, stress on the first. And in British English, the r in never is silent before a consonant.
scenes.say_uz: Interesting: uch bo‘g‘in, urg‘u birinchisida. Britaniya inglizchasida never dagi r undosh oldida aytilmaydi.

scenes.title: Stress bilan bog‘liq xatolar
board: ✗ Cramming new words the night before
✗ Panicking after one hard question
✗ Changing your plan in the middle of the exam
scenes.say_native: Stress bilan bog‘liq uchta xato. Birinchisi, oxirgi kechada yangi so‘z yodlash: bu uyquni buzadi va xavotirni oshiradi. Ikkinchisi, bitta qiyin savoldan keyin vahimaga tushish. Bitta savol butun imtihon emas, keyingi savol oson bo‘lishi mumkin. Uchinchisi, imtihon o‘rtasida tayyor rejani tashlab yuborish. Reja aynan stress paytida sizni ushlab turadi.
scenes.say: Don't cram the night before. One hard question is one mark. And stick to your plan.
scenes.say_uz: Oxirgi kechada yodlamang. Bitta qiyin savol bitta ball xolos. Rejangizga sodiq qoling.

scenes.title: Nima qilasiz?
board: 1) Speaking Part 2: your mind goes blank.
2) Listening: you miss two answers in a row.
3) Writing: 10 minutes left, Task 2 half done.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta vaziyat. Har birida nima qilishingizni inglizcha bir-ikki gap bilan ayting. Birinchi: gapirishning ikkinchi qismida xayolingiz bo‘shab qoldi. Ikkinchi: tinglashda ketma-ket ikki javobni o‘tkazib yubordingiz. Uchinchi: yozishda o‘n daqiqa qoldi, ikkinchi topshiriq yarim yozilgan.
scenes.say: What would you do? One. In Speaking Part 2, your mind goes blank. Two. In Listening, you miss two answers in a row. Three. In Writing, ten minutes are left and Task 2 is half done.
scenes.say_uz: Nima qilardingiz? Bir. Gapirishning ikkinchi qismida xayolingiz bo‘shab qoldi. Ikki. Tinglashda ketma-ket ikki javobni o‘tkazib yubordingiz. Uch. Yozishda o‘n daqiqa qoldi, ikkinchi topshiriq yarim tayyor.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) Use a time-buying phrase; go back to your notes
2) Guess, let them go, follow the next question
3) Finish the main points; write a short conclusion
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: vaqt yutadigan ibora ayting va bir daqiqalik tayyorgarlikda yozgan qaydlaringizga qarang, keyingi bandga o‘ting. Ikkinchi: taxminiy javob qoldiring, ularni unuting va keyingi savolni kuzating. Uchinchi: asosiy fikrlarni qisqa yakunlang va albatta qisqa xulosa yozing. Xulosasiz insho tugallanmagan ko‘rinadi.
scenes.say: Buy time, then check your notes. Guess and follow the next question. Wrap up and write a short conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqt yuting, keyin qaydlarga qarang. Taxmin qiling va keyingi savolni kuzating. Yakunlang va qisqa xulosa yozing.

scenes.title: Uchinchi nuqta: savollarni tartiblash
board: Two passes: easy first, hard later
Flag (belgilang) and move on
Every question is worth the same mark
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: savollarni tartiblash. IELTS o‘qish va tinglashda har bir savol bir xil ball beradi, qiyin savol ham, oson savol ham. Demak, avval ishonchli javob beradigan savollarni yeching, qiyinlarini belgilab qo‘ying va ikkinchi aylanishda qayting. Bu ikki aylanish usuli deyiladi. U vaqtni tejaydi va oson ballarni yo‘qotmaslikka yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Each question carries the same mark, so the hard ones aren't worth more. Work in two passes: answer what you can, flag the rest, and come back later.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir savol bir xil ball beradi, qiyinlari qimmatroq emas. Ikki aylanishda ishlang: bilganingizga javob bering, qolganini belgilang va keyin qayting.

scenes.title: Bo‘sh joy qoldirmang
board: No negative marking in IELTS or C1 Advanced
A blank = 0, a guess = a chance
Guess smart: grammar, word limit, logic
scenes.say_native: Muhim fakt: IELTS da ham, C1 Advanced da ham noto‘g‘ri javob uchun ball ayirilmaydi. Demak, bo‘sh joy aniq nol, taxmin esa imkoniyat. Hech qachon javobni bo‘sh qoldirmang. Lekin aqlli taxmin qiling: bo‘shliqqa grammatik jihatdan qanday so‘z mos, so‘z chekloviga to‘g‘ri keladimi, mantiqan to‘g‘rimi. Variantli savolda aniq noto‘g‘rilarini chiqarib tashlang.
scenes.say: There's no negative marking, so a guess can only help. Check the grammar of the gap and the word limit.
scenes.say_uz: Ball ayirilmaydi, shuning uchun taxmin faqat foyda beradi. Bo‘shliq grammatikasi va so‘z cheklovini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Savollar tartibi va matn
board: Many task types follow the order of the text
Q5 is between the answers to Q4 and Q6
Exception: e.g. matching headings, matching information
scenes.say_native: Yana bir foydali bilim. Ko‘p topshiriq turlarida savollar matndagi tartibda keladi, masalan gap to‘ldirish yoki True, False, Not Given topshirig‘ida. Agar to‘rtinchi va oltinchi savol javobini topgan bo‘lsangiz, beshinchisi ularning orasida. Lekin hamma topshiriqda emas: sarlavhalarni moslash yoki ma’lumotni xatboshiga moslashda tartib yo‘q. Topshiriq turini bilsangiz, qidirish tezlashadi.
scenes.say: If you've found answers four and six, answer five is somewhere in between. Matching tasks are the exception.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtinchi va oltinchi javobni topgan bo‘lsangiz, beshinchisi ularning orasida. Moslash topshiriqlari bundan mustasno.

scenes.title: Yozishda ustuvorlik
board: Task 2 first? Possible, if Task 1 makes you nervous
Must-haves: answer every part of the question
Conclusion > perfect introduction
scenes.say_native: Yozishda ham ustuvorlik bor. Ikkinchi topshiriq og‘irroq, shuning uchun ba’zi nomzodlar uni birinchi yozadi. Bu ruxsat etilgan, muhimi vaqtni nazorat qilish. Har bir topshiriqda eng muhimi savolning barcha qismlariga javob berish. Agar vaqt tugayotgan bo‘lsa, kirishni mukammallashtirish o‘rniga xulosani yozing. Tugallangan, aniq javob chiroyli, lekin chala javobdan yaxshiroq.
scenes.say: Answer every part of the question. If time is short, a clear conclusion beats a perfect introduction.
scenes.say_uz: Savolning har bir qismiga javob bering. Vaqt kam bo‘lsa, aniq xulosa mukammal kirishdan yaxshiroq.

scenes.title: Mukammallikka intilish xatosi
board: ✗ Rewriting the introduction three times
✗ Doing the questions strictly in order
✗ Leaving blanks 'to come back later' – and forgetting
scenes.say_native: Uchta ustuvorlik xatosi. Birinchisi, kirish qismini uch marta qayta yozish: bu mukammallikka intilish, lekin vaqt boshqa joyda kerak. Ikkinchisi, savollarni qat’iy tartibda yechish va qiyin savolda qotib qolish. Uchinchisi, keyin qaytaman deb bo‘sh joy qoldirish va unutish. Belgilagan savolingizga albatta taxminiy javob yozib qo‘ying, keyin qaytsangiz, uni o‘zgartirasiz.
scenes.say: Don't polish your introduction three times. When you flag a question, write a guess straight away.
scenes.say_uz: Kirishni uch marta sayqallamang. Savolni belgilaganda darhol taxmin yozing.

scenes.title: Ustuvorlikni belgilang
board: You have 15 minutes left in Reading:
A) 6 T/F/NG questions (easy for you)
B) 1 summary gap you've been stuck on
C) 5 matching headings (not started)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. O‘qish bo‘limida o‘n besh daqiqa qoldi. Uchta ish bor: A, sizga oson oltita True, False, Not Given savoli. B, uzoq vaqt qotib qolgan bitta bo‘shliq. C, boshlanmagan beshta sarlavha moslash savoli. Qaysi tartibda ishlaysiz va nega? Javobni inglizcha ayting.
scenes.say: Fifteen minutes left. A: six true, false, not given questions you find easy. B: one summary gap you've been stuck on. C: five matching headings you haven't started. In what order would you work?
scenes.say_uz: O‘n besh daqiqa qoldi. A: oson oltita True, False, Not Given. B: qotib qolgan bitta bo‘shliq. C: boshlanmagan beshta sarlavha. Qaysi tartibda ishlaysiz?

scenes.title: Javob
board: A → C → B
A: 6 quick marks · C: 5 marks
B: 1 mark – guess now, return if time
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: A, keyin C, oxirida B. A sizga oson, oltita ballni tez olasiz. C da beshta ball bor, hali boshlanmagan bo‘lsa ham, ularga vaqt kerak. B esa faqat bitta ball va siz unda allaqachon qotib qolgansiz. Shuning uchun B ga hozir taxminiy javob yozing va vaqt qolsa qayting. Ballar soniga qarab qaror qiling, hissiyotga qarab emas.
scenes.say: A first: six quick marks. Then C: five marks waiting. B last: it's worth only one mark, so write a guess now and return if there's time.
scenes.say_uz: Avval A: oltita tez ball. Keyin C: beshta ball kutib turibdi. B oxirida: u faqat bitta ball, shuning uchun hozir taxmin yozing va vaqt bo‘lsa qayting.

scenes.title: Tinglash: gapirish imtihoni haqida
board: Dilshod: My mind went completely blank in Part 2.
Teacher: What did you do?
Dilshod: I used one of those phrases.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Dilshod gapirish imtihonidan keyin o‘qituvchisiga nima bo‘lganini aytib bermoqda. Ikkinchi qismda xayoli bo‘shab qolgan. U qanday chiqib ketganiga va o‘qituvchi nima deganiga e’tibor bering. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz. Uning so‘zlarini aynan eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Dilshod: My mind went completely blank in Part 2. Teacher: Oh no. What did you do? Dilshod: I said, that's an interesting question, let me think for a second. Then I looked at my notes and just started with the first point. Teacher: Perfect. Did you keep going? Dilshod: Yes, I spoke until the examiner stopped me. Teacher: Then you handled it well. Silence costs far more than a small pause.
scenes.say_uz: Dilshod: Ikkinchi qismda xayolim butunlay bo‘shab qoldi. O‘qituvchi: Voy. Nima qildingiz? Dilshod: Qiziq savol, bir soniya o‘ylab olay, dedim. Keyin qaydlarimga qarab, birinchi banddan boshladim. O‘qituvchi: Ajoyib. Davom etdingizmi? Dilshod: Ha, imtihon oluvchi to‘xtatguncha gapirdim. O‘qituvchi: Demak, yaxshi uddaladingiz. Jimlik kichik pauzadan ancha qimmatga tushadi.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What happened to Dilshod in Part 2?
2) Name two things he did.
3) What is the teacher's main point?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: ikkinchi qismda Dilshod bilan nima yuz berdi? Ikkinchi: u vaziyatdan chiqish uchun qilgan ikki ishni ayting. Uchinchi: o‘qituvchining asosiy fikri nima? Javoblaringizni qisqa, lekin to‘liq inglizcha gap bilan bering. Dialogdagi aniq iboralardan foydalaning.
scenes.say: One. What happened to Dilshod in Part 2? Two. Name two things he did. Three. What is the teacher's main point?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Ikkinchi qismda Dilshod bilan nima bo‘ldi? Ikki. U qilgan ikki ishni ayting. Uch. O‘qituvchining asosiy fikri nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) His mind went blank
2) Used a time-buying phrase; looked at his notes
3) Silence costs more than a short pause
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uning xayoli butunlay bo‘shab qoldi, inglizcha my mind went blank. Ikkinchi: vaqt yutadigan ibora ishlatdi va qaydlariga qarab birinchi banddan boshladi, keyin imtihon oluvchi to‘xtatguncha gapirdi. Uchinchi: jimlik kichik pauzadan ancha qimmatga tushadi. Bu dialog bugungi ikki nuqtani birlashtiradi: stressni boshqarish va tayyor usul.
scenes.say: His mind went blank. He used a phrase to buy time and looked at his notes. The teacher's point is that silence costs far more than a short pause.
scenes.say_uz: Uning xayoli bo‘shab qoldi. U vaqt yutish uchun ibora ishlatdi va qaydlariga qaradi. O‘qituvchining fikri: jimlik qisqa pauzadan ancha qimmatga tushadi.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi nuqta: tekshirish strategiyasi
board: Plan the check: it is part of the time plan
Check smart, not everything
Targeted check > rereading all
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: tekshirish. Tekshirish vaqti rejaning bir qismi bo‘lishi kerak, ortib qolsa qilinadigan ish emas. Lekin hammasini qaytadan o‘qishga vaqt bo‘lmaydi. Shuning uchun maqsadli tekshirasiz: eng ko‘p ball yo‘qotiladigan joylarni bilib, faqat ularni ko‘rasiz. Keling, o‘qish, tinglash va yozish uchun alohida ko‘rib chiqamiz.
scenes.say: Build checking time into your plan from the start. There's rarely time to reread everything, so check where marks are most often lost.
scenes.say_uz: Tekshirish vaqtini boshidan rejaga kiriting. Hammasini qayta o‘qishga kamdan-kam vaqt bo‘ladi, shuning uchun ball eng ko‘p yo‘qotiladigan joylarni tekshiring.

scenes.title: O‘qish va tinglashda nimani tekshirish
board: Word limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS
Spelling and plurals: one bag ≠ bags
Right number on the answer sheet?
scenes.say_native: O‘qish va tinglashda uchta narsani tekshiring. Birinchi, so‘z cheklovi: no more than two words deyilgan bo‘lsa, uch so‘z yozgan javob noto‘g‘ri hisoblanadi, mazmuni to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa ham. Ikkinchi, imlo va ko‘plik: matnda bags bo‘lsa, bag yozish xato bo‘lishi mumkin. Uchinchi, javob varaqasidagi raqamlar: bitta savolni tashlab ketsangiz, keyingi barcha javoblar siljib ketadi.
scenes.say: Three words break a two-word limit, even if the meaning is right. Check plurals and answer numbers.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki so‘zlik cheklovda uch so‘z xato, ma’no to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa ham. Ko‘plik va javob raqamlarini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Yozishda nimani tekshirish
board: 1 Task: every part answered? word count?
2 Structure: clear paragraphs, conclusion
3 Your personal error list
scenes.say_native: Yozishda tekshirish tartibi: avval mazmun, keyin til. Birinchi, savolning har bir qismiga javob berdingizmi va so‘z soni yetarlimi. IELTS da birinchi topshiriq kamida yuz ellik, ikkinchisi kamida ikki yuz ellik so‘z. Ikkinchi, xatboshilar aniqmi, xulosa bormi. Uchinchi, oldingi darsdagi shaxsiy xatolar ro‘yxatingiz: he va she, artikllar, predloglar.
scenes.say: Content first, then language. Every part answered? Enough words? Then your own typical errors.
scenes.say_uz: Avval mazmun, keyin til. Har bir qismga javob berildimi? So‘z yetarlimi? Keyin o‘zingizga xos xatolar.

scenes.title: Tekshirishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Changing answers on a vague feeling
✗ Rereading everything from the start
✓ Change only with a clear reason from the text
scenes.say_native: Tekshirishdagi ikki xato. Birinchisi, javobni noaniq hissiyot bilan o‘zgartirish. Agar matnda aniq dalil topmasangiz, birinchi javobingizni qoldiring. O‘zgartirish uchun aniq sabab kerak: matndagi so‘z yoki grammatika. Ikkinchisi, hamma narsani boshidan qayta o‘qish: vaqt tugaydi va eng muhim joylarga yetib bormaysiz. Maqsadli, qisqa tekshirish samaraliroq.
scenes.say: Change an answer only if you find a clear reason in the text, not because it feels wrong.
scenes.say_uz: Javobni noto‘g‘ri tuyulgani uchun emas, faqat matnda aniq sabab topsangiz o‘zgartiring.

scenes.title: Javoblarni tekshiring
board: Instruction: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS
1) The museum opens on (a) public holidays only.
2) Visitors must leave their large bag ___ at reception. (text: 'bags')
3) The tour costs 15 ___ (text: '15 pounds per person')
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ko‘rsatma: ikki so‘zdan ko‘p emas. Uchta javobni tekshiring. Birinchi javob: public holidays only, bu uch so‘z. Ikkinchisida matnda bags, nomzod bag yozgan. Uchinchisida bo‘shliqqa pounds per person yozilgan. Har birida muammo bormi va qanday tuzatasiz? Javobingizni ayting.
scenes.say: The instruction says no more than two words. One: a candidate wrote public holidays only. Two: the text says bags, but the candidate wrote bag. Three: after fifteen, the candidate wrote pounds per person. Any problems?
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rsatma: ikki so‘zdan ko‘p emas. Bir: nomzod public holidays only yozdi. Ikki: matnda bags, nomzod bag yozdi. Uch: o‘n beshdan keyin pounds per person yozdi. Muammo bormi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) ✗ 3 words → ✓ public holidays
2) ✗ bag → ✓ bags (visitors … their large bags)
3) ✗ pounds per person → ✓ pounds
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uch so‘z, cheklovdan oshgan. To‘g‘risi public holidays, only so‘zi gapning qolgan qismida bor. Ikkinchi: their large bags, chunki visitors ko‘plikda va matnda ham bags. Uchinchi: pounds per person uch so‘z va per person allaqachon ma’lum, shuning uchun faqat pounds. Uchala holatda ham ma’no to‘g‘ri edi, lekin ball yo‘qotilar edi.
scenes.say: Public holidays, only two words. Their large bags, plural, as in the text. And just pounds, because per person breaks the word limit.
scenes.say_uz: Public holidays, faqat ikki so‘z. Their large bags, matndagidek ko‘plikda. Va faqat pounds, chunki per person so‘z chekloviga sig‘maydi.

scenes.title: Shaxsiy rejangizni ayting
board: In the Reading paper, I'll spend…
If my mind goes blank, I'll…
Before I finish, I'll check…
scenes.say_native: Endi yakuniy ijodiy topshiriq. O‘zingizning shaxsiy imtihon rejangizni inglizcha baland ovozda ayting. Uch qismdan iborat bo‘lsin: vaqtni qanday taqsimlaysiz, stress paytida nima qilasiz va oxirida nimani tekshirasiz. Ekrandagi gap boshlanishlaridan foydalaning. Kamida to‘rt-besh gap ayting.
scenes.say: Now say your personal exam plan out loud. In the Reading paper, I'll spend. If my mind goes blank, I'll. Before I finish, I'll check.
scenes.say_uz: Endi shaxsiy imtihon rejangizni ovoz chiqarib ayting. O‘qish bo‘limida men sarflayman. Xayolim bo‘shab qolsa, men. Tugatishdan oldin men tekshiraman.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I'll spend 17, 20 and 23 minutes on the passages.
If my mind goes blank, I'll breathe out slowly and flag the question.
Before I finish, I'll check word limits and plurals.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. In the Reading paper, I’ll spend about seventeen, twenty and twenty-three minutes on the three passages, and transfer my answers after each one. If my mind goes blank, I’ll breathe out slowly, write a guess and flag the question. Before I finish, I’ll check word limits, spelling and plurals. Sizning rejangiz o‘zingizga mos bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: I'll spend seventeen, twenty and twenty-three minutes on the passages. If my mind goes blank, I'll breathe out slowly. Before I finish, I'll check word limits.
scenes.say_uz: Matnlarga o‘n yetti, yigirma va yigirma uch daqiqa sarflayman. Xayolim bo‘shab qolsa, sekin nafas chiqaraman. Tugatishdan oldin so‘z cheklovini tekshiraman.

scenes.title: Qisqa takrorlash
board: 1 Time plan: minutes per mark, checkpoints
2 Stress: breathe, self-talk, buy time
3 Prioritise: easy first, never blank
4 Check: word limits, plurals, your errors
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Birinchi: vaqt rejasi, har bir ballga vaqt va savol varaqasidagi nazorat nuqtalari. Ikkinchi: stress, uzun nafas chiqarish, foydali ichki ovoz va gapirishda vaqt yutadigan iboralar. Uchinchi: ustuvorlik, avval oson savollar, belgilab o‘tish va hech qachon bo‘sh joy qoldirmaslik. To‘rtinchi: maqsadli tekshirish, so‘z cheklovi, ko‘plik va shaxsiy xatolaringiz.
scenes.say: Plan your time, control your stress, do the easy questions first, and check where marks are lost.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqtni rejalang, stressni boshqaring, avval oson savollarni yeching va ball yo‘qotiladigan joylarni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: one timed section (e.g. Reading, 60 min)
Review every mistake: time · knowledge · careless
Success: finished on time, all mistakes classified
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bitta bo‘limni, masalan o‘qishni, haqiqiy vaqt bilan ishlang va bugungi rejaga amal qiling. Keyin har bir xatoni tahlil qilib, uch turga ajrating: vaqt yetmagani, bilim yetishmagani yoki e’tiborsizlik. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: bo‘limni vaqtida tugatish va barcha xatolarni sababi bilan yozib chiqish. Keyingi darsda gapirish va yozish bo‘yicha to‘liq sinov imtihonini o‘tkazamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, do one timed section and classify every mistake. Next time: a full Speaking and Writing mock.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: bitta bo‘limni vaqt bilan ishlang va har bir xatoni turkumlang. Keyingi safar: gapirish va yozish bo‘yicha to‘liq sinov.

homework_uz: Bitta bo‘limni (masalan, IELTS o‘qish, 60 daqiqa) haqiqiy vaqt bilan, bugungi reja asosida ishlang. Keyin har bir xatoni tahlil qilib, uch turga ajrating: vaqt yetmagani, bilim yetishmagani yoki e’tiborsizlik. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: bo‘limni vaqtida tugatish va barcha xatolarni sababi bilan yozib chiqish.

quiz.q: In IELTS Reading you have 60 minutes for 40 questions. Roughly how long is that per question?
quiz.why_uz: 60 daqiqa ÷ 40 savol = taxminan bir yarim daqiqa.

quiz.q: Why should you give Passage 3 more time than Passage 1 in IELTS Reading?
options: It is usually the most difficult.
It is always the longest by far.
quiz.why_uz: Matnlar odatda qiyinlashib boradi, shuning uchun oxirgisiga ko‘proq vaqt ajratiladi.

quiz.q: In IELTS Writing, how much time is usually recommended for Task 2?
quiz.why_uz: Task 2 ga 40 daqiqa tavsiya etiladi, chunki u ballga ikki baravar ko‘p ta’sir qiladi.

quiz.q: You've spent four minutes on one Reading question and still have no answer. What is the best move?
options: Keep going until you find it.
Leave it blank and never return.
Write a guess, flag it and move on.
Start the passage again from the beginning.
quiz.why_uz: Taxmin yozib, belgilab, keyingisiga o‘tasiz; vaqt qolsa qaytasiz.

quiz.q: Is there negative marking in IELTS or C1 Advanced?
options: Yes, one mark is deducted for a wrong answer.
No, so you should never leave a blank.
No, but blanks get half a mark.
quiz.why_uz: Noto‘g‘ri javob uchun ball ayirilmaydi, shuning uchun bo‘sh joy qoldirmang.

quiz.q: Instruction: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Which answer breaks the rule?
quiz.why_uz: The old station uch so‘z, cheklovdan oshadi. Ma’no to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa ham ball berilmaydi.

quiz.q: Which breathing pattern is recommended in the lesson to calm down?
quiz.why_uz: Nafas chiqarish olishdan uzunroq bo‘lsa, tana tinchlanadi: 4 ga olib, 6 ga chiqarish.

quiz.q: Your mind goes blank in the Speaking test. What is the best thing to say?
options: That's an interesting question. Let me think for a moment.
quiz.why_uz: Vaqt yutadigan ibora jimlikdan ancha yaxshi va ravonlikni saqlaydi.

quiz.q: When should you transfer your answers in the paper-based IELTS Reading test?
options: During the 10 minutes given at the end
After each passage, because there is no extra transfer time
You don't need to; the question paper is marked
quiz.why_uz: Qog‘ozdagi o‘qishda ko‘chirish uchun qo‘shimcha vaqt yo‘q. 10 daqiqa faqat tinglash uchun beriladi.

quiz.q: When is it a good idea to change an answer during checking?
options: When you find a clear reason in the text
quiz.why_uz: Javob faqat matnda aniq sabab topilganda o‘zgartiriladi, noaniq hissiyot bilan emas.
